requirements.text: Field-bus commands that change device behaviour must be authenticated and write-protected while the device is in run mode.
Local commissioning access must require a changed, non-default credential and lock out after repeated failed attempts.
Firmware updates must be cryptographically authenticated and protected against rollback to vulnerable versions; debug interfaces must be disabled in production.
Any routable network option (e.g. Ethernet-APL) must be disabled by default and ship with explicit network-segmentation guidance.
The device must detect and reject implausible or abruptly-changing level readings before they are reported to the control system.
